description: Price the capital stack that buys a business with the least of the buyer's own cash, from seller-financed and contingent structures. Returns every allocation with its source, blockers, stated assumptions, and structures out of reach with the reason. Arithmetic on the figures given, not advice. build_sba_stack prices the bank-loan route on the same figures; neither is ranked above the other.

cash.description: Cash the buyer will put in, in dollars. Defaults to 0.

growth.description: Monthly growth percentage. Defaults to 0; growth claims are never priced in.

margin.description: Gross margin as a percentage. Defaults to 80.

mindscr.description: Minimum debt service cover the business must clear. Defaults to 1.25.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue in dollars, from collections where known.

opex.description: Monthly operating cost the buyer will carry, including replacing the owner. Defaults to 0, which is flagged as an unpriced owner.

name: build_stack
